Operations.Name: DeleteAuthLdapById
Operations.Description: Delete an LDAP provider configuration by id (enterprise only)

Operations.Name: DeleteAuthOidcById
Operations.Description: Delete an OIDC provider configuration by id

Operations.Name: DeleteAuthTokensById
Operations.Description: Revoke (permanently delete) one of the authenticated user's API tokens

Operations.Name: GetAuthLdap
Operations.Description: List all configured LDAP providers (enterprise only; bind passwords are masked)

Operations.Name: GetAuthLdapById
Operations.Description: Get a single LDAP provider configuration by id (enterprise only; bind password is masked)

Operations.Name: GetAuthOidc
Operations.Description: List all configured OIDC providers (client secrets are masked)

Operations.Name: GetAuthOidcById
Operations.Description: Get a single OIDC provider configuration by id (client secret is masked)

Operations.Name: GetAuthOidcByIdInitiate
Operations.Description: Start the OIDC login flow for a provider — on success throws a 302 redirect to the IdP authorization URL

Options.Name: redirect
Options.Description: Post-login destination path to return to (defaults to /)

Operations.Name: GetAuthOidcCallback
Operations.Description: Handle the OIDC redirect callback from the IdP — always responds with a 302 redirect (to the original destination on success, or to /login with an error query param on failure)

Options.Name: code
Options.Description: Authorization code returned by the IdP

Options.Name: state
Options.Description: Opaque state value used to correlate the request and carry the post-login redirect

Options.Name: error
Options.Description: Error code returned by the IdP when authentication failed

Options.Name: error_description
Options.Description: Human-readable error detail returned by the IdP

Operations.Name: GetAuthProviders
Operations.Description: List the authentication providers offered on the login page (local, LDAP, OIDC), plus the default provider

Operations.Name: GetAuthSession
Operations.Description: Get the current session (public — used by the frontend to bootstrap auth state)

Operations.Name: GetAuthSettings
Operations.Description: Get the global authentication settings (whether auth is enabled and the default provider)

Operations.Name: GetAuthTokens
Operations.Description: List the authenticated user's API tokens (never returns the hash/secret)

Operations.Name: PostAuthLdap
Operations.Description: Create a new LDAP provider configuration (enterprise only)

Operations.Name: PostAuthLdapByIdTest
Operations.Description: Test connectivity of a stored LDAP configuration by id (enterprise only)

Operations.Name: PostAuthLogin
Operations.Description: Authenticate with username/password (local or LDAP) and set the session cookie

Operations.Name: PostAuthLogout
Operations.Description: Destroy the current session (clears the dockhand_session cookie)

Operations.Name: PostAuthOidc
Operations.Description: Create a new OIDC provider configuration

Operations.Name: PostAuthOidcByIdInitiate
Operations.Description: Return the OIDC authorization URL for a provider without redirecting (JSON response)

Operations.Name: PostAuthOidcByIdTest
Operations.Description: Test the discovery/connection of a stored OIDC configuration by id

Operations.Name: PostAuthTokens
Operations.Description: Create a new API token for the authenticated user (requires a session, not a Bearer token)

Operations.Name: PutAuthLdapById
Operations.Description: Update an existing LDAP provider configuration (only supplied fields change; a masked bindPassword is ignored)

Operations.Name: PutAuthOidcById
Operations.Description: Update an existing OIDC provider configuration (only supplied fields change; a masked clientSecret is ignored)

Operations.Name: PutAuthSettings
Operations.Description: Update the global authentication settings (enabling auth requires at least one admin/user to exist)
